tagline: Understand the audience before buying more attention.

positioning.ideal_buyer: Teams planning a campaign or market approach that need legitimate audience and content evidence
positioning.buyer_problem: Content is produced without a clear evidence-backed understanding of the audience.
positioning.intended_outcome: A scoped audience and campaign intelligence engagement

delivery_contract.deliverable_to_scope: A written audience-signal analysis and agreed launch recommendations based on permitted evidence
delivery_contract.buyer_inputs: Intended audience, legitimate public or authorized sources, current channels, business goal and timing
delivery_contract.acceptance_criteria_to_agree: Audience scope, allowed sources, planned analysis, report format and timeline
delivery_contract.exclusions: No scraping private accounts, surveillance, guaranteed engagement, follower growth or campaign ROI

discovery_intents: research audience for a product launch
acquisition.content_angle: Better audience understanding comes before better posting frequency.
acquisition.approved_example_copy: Launching into an audience you don't really understand? Evercraft Social Intelligence is a $1,000 scoped engagement that turns authorized audience signals into a practical launch brief.
acquisition.distribution_rule: Use owned or authorized channels and qualified, permissioned audiences only. Do not claim posts, leads, conversion or revenue without source receipts.

evercraft_os.relationship: Independent market-facing product, sharing future Evercraft OS capabilities
evercraft_os.module_context: Evercraft OS / Research & Distribution (shared capability goal, not proven automation)

launch_evidence: Existing exact-price Stripe service page tested historically, with owner-shared buyer-view screenshots. This is not a new live purchase or automated delivery attestation.

identity.signature_phrase: Listen for the pattern, then launch.
identity.purpose: Help teams understand real audience patterns before committing effort to a launch.
identity.narrative_promise: Know the room before raising the volume.
